verdict.rationale: Delegating work to built-in AI agents is LightSprint's core function. Users describe a change in plain English and the product builds it with a live preview and prepares it for review. Background cloud agents clear bug backlogs, plans can be handed off as one implementation task, and agents capture screenshots and video of their work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing-level claims about how the delegated agent behaves.
